biggest_catch: This is betting, not income: exchange bets are zero-sum between users minus Smarkets' commission, outcomes are uncertain, and there is no guaranteed payout of any kind.
catches: Betting exchange = gambling: you bet against other users (back/lay), and losing bets lose 100% of the stake.
Smarkets charges 2% commission on net winnings per market (Standard Tier), so every winning position keeps 2% less than the market price implies.
Commission tiers can change what you pay: accounts can move to Pro (1% on winnings or losses per trade) or Select (3%) tiers; confirm your tier in official terms.

Addiction risk: real-money betting with uncertain outcomes.

Deposit funds into the account (your own money; no signup fee).
